cohort: 560 pregnant women who underwent labor induction for medical reasons
finding: Gestational age less than 38 weeks was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section in the misoprostol group, and nulliparous women over 35 years old had a significantly increased risk of cesarean section in both groups.
mod_finding: This study found an increased risk of Cesarean delivery in women induced with dinoprostone who were nulliparous, had hypertension, and whose intertrochanteric dimensions were consistent with a mother's height of less than 165 cm, as well as in women induced with misoprostol who were 35 years of age or older, nulliparous, had hypertension, or were less than 38 weeks gestation.
